text: Periosteum is a fibrous membrane that wraps the outer surface of bones.
Cortical bone is the dense compact outer layer of the bone.
Trabecular, cancellous, or spongy bone (spongiosa) is a porous network of tissue filling the interior of bone, decreasing weight and allowing room for blood vessels and marrow.
Involvement through cortical bone is required for assignment of code 7.
